source.title: 87% of the Anthropic power will come from gas and 11% from coal in 2028
source.author: happosai

title.zh: Anthropic数据中心：2028年电力或87%来自天然气
title.en: Anthropic Data Centers May Get 87% of 2028 Power From Gas

excerpt.zh: Anthropic数据中心用电估算显示，2028年美国已签约站点的电力可能有87%来自天然气、11%来自煤炭；排放结果取决于负载和并网电源等假设。
excerpt.en: Anthropic data center power estimates suggest U.S. contracted sites could rely on gas for 87% and coal for 11% of electricity in 2028, subject to key modeling assumptions.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: 一项针对Anthropic数据中心电力来源的案例研究估算，该公司在美国已签约站点到2028年的用电，可能有87%来自天然气、11%来自煤炭。研究机构Better Data Center Project称，这反映了新增数据中心负载可能调用的现场发电和电网边际电源，并非对每个站点实际发电量的直接测量。
text.en: A case study of Anthropic data center power estimates that, by 2028, electricity for the company’s contracted U.S. sites could come 87% from gas and 11% from coal. The Better Data Center Project says this reflects on-site generation and marginal grid resources that may serve added data center load, rather than direct measurements of each site’s actual electricity mix.

text.zh: Anthropic电力估算依赖站点与电网假设
text.en: Anthropic power estimates depend on site and grid assumptions

text.zh: 报告截至2026年10月统计了约15吉瓦已签约算力，其中约5.9至9.6吉瓦对应已确定的具体数据中心站点。作者以现场天然气机组及可能满足新增负载的电网电厂估算电源构成；对没有新增专属电源的并网设施，使用模型推算短期边际发电。因此，报告没有把电网中的可再生能源计入这批新增负载。
text.en: The report counts about 15 GW of contracted compute as of October 2026, with roughly 5.9 to 9.6 GW tied to identified data center sites. Its power mix estimate includes on-site gas generators and grid plants likely to meet incremental demand. For grid-connected sites without new dedicated generation, the authors model short-run marginal power, so they do not attribute existing grid renewables to this new load.

text.zh: 天然气占比与排放预测仍有不确定性
研究估计，相关站点2028年的电力使用排放可能为每年1700万至3800万吨二氧化碳当量，中值约3200万吨。范围来自对平均用电、利用率和冷却能耗等因素的不同假设；中值还假定识别出的9.6吉瓦算力届时全部上线。报告也指出，估算采用短期边际电源来评估新增负载影响，因此不应简单视为Anthropic完整生命周期或最终核算的排放总量。
text.en: The study estimates annual power-related emissions at these sites could reach 17 million to 38 million metric tons of carbon-dioxide equivalent in 2028, with a midpoint of about 32 million. The range reflects assumptions about average electricity use, utilization, and cooling demand; the midpoint also assumes all 9.6 GW of identified compute is online. The analysis uses short-run marginal generators to assess the added load, so it should not be read as a complete lifecycle estimate or a final accounting of Anthropic’s emissions.

text.zh: 研究还将现场燃气设备与空气污染联系起来，指出其估算中的大部分现场容量使用效率较低的简单循环涡轮机和发动机。不过，结果受电厂实际投运时间、许可与污染控制设备、数据中心负载变化，以及电网未来新增电源影响。核心待解问题是，新增算力需求是否会伴随足够的新建清洁电力，以及这些项目能否按计划落地。
text.en: The study also links on-site gas equipment to air pollution, noting that most of the on-site capacity in its estimate uses less efficient simple-cycle turbines and engines. Actual outcomes will depend on when plants operate, their permits and pollution controls, changing data center loads, and future additions to the grid. A central open question is whether new clean power will be built alongside the added compute demand, and whether those projects will materialize on schedule.
